solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Female dog is fat

parts.note: F is the standard abbreviation for female
short for Labrador, a breed of dog

explanation.surface: An unkind remark about an overweight bitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Flab is loose excess body tissue, so the noun fat is a plain synonym.

clue.text: Lovers struggling to install uniform door panels

indicators.note: to install something is to put it inside, so one piece goes within the other
things struggling are writhing about, so the letters are thrown out of their order

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
U is Uniform in the phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A couple fumble together trying to fit door panels.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged letters of the first word take U between O and V.
explanation.definitionFit: Louvres are slatted panels fitted in doors or shutters to let air through while blocking light.

clue.text: Give thanks for bishop? Not so much

parts.note: B is the chess notation for bishop
less means a smaller amount

explanation.surface: A wry query whether one should be grateful for a bishop, with a grudging reply.
explanation.definitionFit: To bless can mean to praise or be thankful for something, as in blessing one's luck.

clue.text: These tasks are out of one's class

definitions.text: These tasks are out of one's class

parts.words: These tasks are out of one's class
parts.note: surface reading: chores that are beneath one's social standing
setter's reading: assignments done outside the classroom, at home

explanation.surface: A snob dismisses certain jobs as beneath their social rank.
explanation.definitionFit: Pupils are set this school work to complete at home, away from lessons.

clue.text: Man has weight to cut down

parts.note: a man is referred to as he
W is the abbreviation for weight; has joins it on

explanation.surface: A heavy man is needed to fell something.
explanation.definitionFit: To hew is to chop or fell with an axe, as in hewing trees.

clue.text: Beggar I am unable to reform?

parts.note: to mend one's ways is to reform
I am unable is I can't

explanation.surface: A beggar laments being incapable of changing their ways.
explanation.walkthrough: The two parts are joined in the reverse of clue order, mending coming first.
explanation.definitionFit: A mendicant is someone who lives by asking for alms, as in mendicant friars.

clue.text: Online discussion group arranged in wine bar

indicators.note: things arranged are set out in a fresh order, so the letters are reordered

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A discussion group meets in a wine bar instead of online.
explanation.definitionFit: A webinar is a seminar held over the internet, with participants joining remotely.

clue.text: Country sport greatly missed in odd places

indicators.note: letters missed at every other position are dropped, leaving only those in the odd positions

parts.note: RU is Rugby Union
really, as in really good, means greatly

explanation.surface: A country's favourite sport is sorely missed in some strange locations.
explanation.walkthrough: Of REALLY only the first, third and fifth letters survive. Country here is an adjective, as in country life.
explanation.definitionFit: Rural describes the countryside rather than towns, the same sense as country used adjectivally.

clue.text: Bird wasn't emu, unfortunately

indicators.note: an unfortunate outcome is things gone awry, so the letters fall out of order

parts.note: taken as written, apostrophe ignored, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Disappointment that a sighted bird turned out not to be an emu.
explanation.definitionFit: The mute swan is the common white swan of Britain and Europe, a species of bird.

clue.text: Exclude one Italian port

parts.note: to bar someone is to exclude them
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An instruction to leave one Italian harbour off a list.
explanation.definitionFit: Bari is a major seaport on the Adriatic coast of southern Italy, capital of Apulia.

clue.text: Girl crushed by satirist

indicators.note: something crushed by another is squeezed inside it, so the letters sit within the next word

parts.note: the middle letters of this word

explanation.surface: A young woman is flattened by a mocking writer's wit.
explanation.definitionFit: Iris is a female first name, so it stands for a girl in crossword style.

clue.text: Complicated love affair that may offer a warning

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a romance involving three people
second meaning: the red roadside sign placed behind a broken-down car

explanation.walkthrough: The second meaning is the warning triangle drivers set out after a breakdown.
explanation.definitionFit: A love triangle involves three people, and a warning triangle is a three-sided reflective sign.

clue.text: Try out striker for international

parts.note: to test is to try out
a match is struck to make fire

explanation.surface: A footballer is given a trial for the national team.
explanation.walkthrough: Striker suggests a footballer but is a thing that gets struck. A test match is an international game of cricket or rugby.
explanation.definitionFit: A test match is a game between national teams, and an international is the noun for such a game.

clue.text: Lives next to a model, in present circumstances

parts.note: taken as written
to model for an artist is to sit
is means exists or lives

explanation.surface: Someone resides beside a fashion model, as things stand.
explanation.walkthrough: Next to places the first word after the other two.
explanation.definitionFit: As it is means things being the way they currently are, the same idea as present circumstances.

clue.text: May child run, a tea being cooked?

indicators.note: food being cooked is transformed, so these letters are mixed into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A child is asked to hurry while tea is being prepared.
explanation.walkthrough: May looks like permission, but it is the month.
explanation.definitionFit: A Taurean is born under Taurus, the star sign covering late April to late May.

clue.text: Seize a bit of a break from speaking

indicators.note: coming from speaking means the words are taken as they sound said out loud

parts.note: a short break is a rest

explanation.surface: A grab at a brief pause in conversation.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrest a suspect is to seize and detain them.

clue.text: Puts off husband surrounded by personalities

indicators.note: something surrounded by another is enclosed within it

parts.note: one's selves are one's personalities
H is the abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A husband postpones things because of the strong characters around him.
explanation.definitionFit: To shelve a plan is to postpone it, so shelves means puts off.

clue.text: Engineers surrender table again

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
to submit is to surrender

explanation.surface: Engineers give up a table to someone.
explanation.walkthrough: Table is a verb here, as in tabling a motion.
explanation.definitionFit: To table a proposal is to submit it, so to table again is to resubmit.

clue.text: Prepare to publish Hot Girl

parts.note: editing readies text for publication
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A magazine story about an attractive woman is being readied for print.
explanation.definitionFit: Edith is a female first name, so it stands for a girl in crossword style.

clue.text: Expected time for couple's performance

parts.note: due means expected, as in due at noon
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A pair's turn on stage is coming up.
explanation.definitionFit: A duet is a piece performed by two musicians or singers together.

clue.text: Receiving fine does perhaps delay

indicators.note: receiving something means taking it in, so one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: does are female deer; perhaps flags the example
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: Someone receiving a penalty might put off paying it.
explanation.walkthrough: Does reads as a verb but is the plural of doe.
explanation.definitionFit: To defer is to postpone or put off, the same as delay used as a verb.

clue.text: Intelligent questions heard

indicators.note: heard means what follows is taken by its sound

parts.note: questions beginning why are whys

explanation.surface: Clever enquiries are being listened to.
explanation.definitionFit: Wise means having good judgement and knowledge, close in sense to intelligent.

clue.text: Have a break, after four attempts to shoot?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: an idiom for pausing to rest
second meaning: the fifth attempt at filming a scene

explanation.walkthrough: Shoot means filming, not firing a gun; a take is one recorded attempt at a scene, so the fifth comes after four.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means pause for a short rest, and literally the phrase labels the next recording on a film set.

clue.text: Stun one carp

parts.note: a knockout, KO, stuns an opponent
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Stunning a single fish before landing it.
explanation.walkthrough: Carp is the fish, not the verb meaning complain.
explanation.definitionFit: Koi are ornamental Japanese carp kept in garden ponds.

clue.text: Mix hash with a gin and port

indicators.note: to mix things is to stir them together, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written
the article, joined on by with
taken as written

explanation.surface: A bartender's recipe combining hash, gin and a fortified wine.
explanation.walkthrough: Port looks like the drink joining hash and gin, but it is the harbour city.
explanation.definitionFit: Shanghai is China's largest city and one of the world's busiest seaports.

clue.text: Fungus beginning to spread in furrow

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a rut is a groove or furrow

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its opening letter, so only that is kept

parts.note: the opening letter of this word

explanation.surface: A plant disease starts spreading along a ploughed line.
explanation.definitionFit: Rust is a fungal disease of plants that leaves reddish spots, and also the fungus causing it.
